text: {"findings":[{"type":"PRIOR_ART","title":"Repeats EXP-014 (10-minute ETA buffer) without referencing it","detail":"EXP-014 already tested a 10-minute buffer on promise windows. It raised On-Time Delivery Rate by 3.1 pts, but checkout conversion fell 1.2% and the gain came from relaxed promises, not faster delivery. The proposal does not mention this experiment or explain how it differs. The result was concluded and not shipped.","evidence_quote":"Add a 10-minute buffer to promise windows in the three worst-performing zones to lift on-time rate.","citations":["experiment-registry#exp-014-eta-buffer"],"recommendation":"Reference EXP-014, explain what is different (zone targeting, measurement), and justify why the outcome would change. Otherwise do not re-run it."},{"type":"MISSING_GUARDRAIL","title":"No conversion guardrail for a promise-window change","detail":"EXP-014 learned that promise changes must be judged on Promise Accuracy and conversion, not on on-time rate alone. The proposal guards Promise Accuracy but has no checkout conversion guardrail. That was the metric that regressed in the prior test.","evidence_quote":"- Promise Accuracy: median error must not worsen.","citations":["experiment-registry#exp-014-eta-buffer"],"recommendation":"Add checkout conversion as a guardrail with a numeric stop threshold, and include it in the pre-registered stopping rule."}]}
